27: Heat generated per second when resisting burn damage.
28: Increases the "strength" of one crew member when attacking another ship to capture it. Each crew member can only wield one weapon at a time, but they will use whichever weapons provide the highest power.
29: Increases the "strength" of one crew member when defending against an attempt to capture this ship. Each crew member can only wield one weapon at a time, but they will use whichever weapons provide the highest power.
30: Tons of cargo this ship is carrying right now, out of its maximum.
31: Allows scanning of your target ship's cargo from up to this distance away.
32: Allows scanning of your target ship's cargo. The range of this cargo scanner is proportional to the square root of this value.
33: Determines how long it takes to perform a cargo scan. A higher value will correspond to a quicker scan.
34: The maximum speed of this cargo scanner is proportional to the square root of this value. The observed scan speed will be impacted by multiple factors. Targets which are farther away or have a larger cargo hold will take longer to scan.
35: Increases the time required for other ships to perform a cargo scan of this ship. A value of one has the same influence on the time taken as adding one more ton of cargo space to scan.
36: Tons of cargo (commodities, mission cargo, and plundered outfits) this ship can carry.
37: Tons of cargo space this outfit uses up.
38: This outfit allows your ship to cloak. The value represents how long it takes to fully activate or deactivate cloaking. Ships cannot fire while cloaked, except if they have the related "cloaked firing" attribute.
39: This outfit allows your ship to cloak. The value represents how long it takes to fully activate or deactivate cloaking for a ship with 1000 mass. The higher a ship's mass, the slower the cloak works, the lower its mass, the faster the cloak works. Ships cannot fire while cloaked, except if they have the related "cloaked firing" attribute.
40: Energy consumed per second when cloaked.
41: Fuel consumed per second when cloaked.
42: Heat generated per second when cloaked.
43: Shields consumed per second while cloaked.
44: This ship is unable to regenerate shields whilst cloaked, instead its shield regeneration will suffer a delay that will grow the longer it is cloaked
45: Hull consumed per second while cloaked.
46: This ship is unable to regenerate hull whilst cloaked, instead its hull regeneration will suffer a delay that will grow the longer it is cloaked.
47: Protection provided against weapons that do hull damage when the cloak is active. Increases by the given factor how much hull damage a ship can withstand before it loses as much energy as an unprotected ship.
48: Protection provided against weapons that do shield damage when the cloak is active. Increases by the given factor how much shield damage a ship can withstand before it loses as much energy as an unprotected ship.
49: When cloaked, weapons cannot affect this ship, and pass right through.
50: This device is so efficient at hiding you that you may shoot when cloaking, losing this amount of cloaking in the process, before being cloaked again. A negative value means shooting does not even hinder your cloak.
51: If you have hull lower than this value (seen as a % between 0 and 1) the cloaking device can no longer operate.
52: Heat dissipated per second. This is for when your ship's built-in heat dissipation is not sufficient to keep it from overheating.
